name: Blessed Silver Ingot
description: A purified ingot used for anti-undead forging recipes.
specialEffects: Required for crafting holy-tier weapons and relic housings.

steps: Refine raw stock for Blessed Silver Ingot under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Crusader Refinery protocol before storage.
